# Account audit: Northwind Labs

## Headline

Free Trial search takes 46% of spend (18,400 / 40,000, campaign-export.csv rows 2 to 6) and produced 0 enterprise opportunities in September (crm-outcomes.csv, rows with 500+). Enterprise search and LinkedIn produced 7 of the 11 enterprise opportunities.

## Data limits

CRM data covers September only; July and August were lost in a migration (crm-outcomes.csv header note). One month is too short to judge closed revenue. Not supported by the data provided: revenue per channel.

## Mismatched periods

Spend is a Q3 total; CRM outcomes are September only. A cost per opportunity from dividing one by the other would be wrong, so this audit does not calculate it. Needed: September spend by campaign.

## Landing page

The landing page has no demo path for enterprise visitors (landing-page.md), which limits any campaign change. Fixing it is out of scope (contract.md §4); see open question 4 in the brief.
